families.label: Earthquake warning
families.trigger: Player-aware warning near an active fall zone
families.admission: Queue only while the warning remains timely

families.label: Rare material discovery
families.trigger: First discovery of a named rare material
families.admission: Once per material identity per save

families.label: Deep expedition return
families.trigger: Surface return after at least 300 m and five minutes away

families.label: Hardcore danger
families.trigger: Entry into a critical danger episode
families.admission: Once per episode; never every damage tick

families.label: Meaningful purchase
families.trigger: First tier purchase or spend of at least 20 percent of wallet
families.admission: Drop while busy; never every shop open or item

families.label: Biome first entry
families.trigger: First stable entry into a named biome
families.admission: Once per biome per save; ignore border oscillation

families.label: Personal combo record
families.trigger: Saved record beaten by a meaningful margin
families.admission: Once per run; never fixed combo ticks

families.label: Inventory critical
families.trigger: Inventory crosses into the final safe capacity band
families.admission: Edge-triggered; re-arm only after capacity recovers

families.label: Star release
families.trigger: A trapped Star is successfully released
families.admission: Once per Star identity after release authority confirms

clips.speaker: player-candidate
clips.text: The stone is shifting beneath us. Stay close, keep your light low, and wait for my signal.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: That tremor was the warning. Get clear of the ceiling, watch the falling stone, and move when I move.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: The ground is rolling toward us. Leave the loose rock behind and find a clean path to open ground.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: Hear that deep crack? The chamber is failing. Stay out of the marked fall zone and keep moving.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: Seismic pressure is climbing fast. Step away from the fracture line before the next collapse lands.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: This vein is different. The crystals are holding their own light. Easy now; we may never see another like it.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: Stop digging for a moment. That color does not belong in ordinary stone, and I want the whole seam intact.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: There it is, a rare deposit buried exactly where the old maps went silent. Mark this depth before we move.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: I can feel the charge through the pick. Whatever this material is, the mountain has hidden it for a long time.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: Fresh air. I almost forgot what it felt like. We came back lighter on supplies and heavier with stories.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: Three hundred meters below and still breathing. Give me a moment at the surface; the dark is still in my eyes.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: The town lights look smaller every time we return, but tonight they look like the brightest thing in the world.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: We made it back. Count the ore, check the gear, and do not ask me how close that last tunnel came.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: One more hit like that and this expedition ends here. Break contact, find cover, and rebuild our Gem Power.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: We are past the safe margin. Stop chasing the vein; survival is worth more than anything still in that wall.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: My hands are shaking, but I can still move. Clear a retreat path now, before the cave decides for us.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: Critical condition. No heroics, no greed. Light the route home and keep every step deliberate.

clips.speaker: bobo-merchant
clips.text: Now that is a serious investment. Treat it well, friend; good equipment remembers the hands that trusted it.

clips.speaker: gear-merchant
clips.text: You chose the upgrade that changes a run, not the one that merely shines. I respect that.

clips.speaker: gem-merchant
clips.text: A fine exchange. Your Gem Power will stretch farther now, but only if you spend it with discipline.

clips.speaker: upgrade-merchant
clips.text: That purchase opens possibilities you could not survive before. Go test it where the ceiling cannot hear us.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: These roots are older than the town above us. They are not growing through the stone; the stone grew around them.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: The cavern is turning blue ahead. Keep the lantern steady; every reflection is hiding another passage.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: Feel that heat in the walls? We have reached the Amber Depths, and the mountain is awake down here.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: Silver in the rock, silver in the dust, silver in the air. We have crossed into the old core workings.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: That is no statue. The stone is breathing around it, as though the entire chamber is trying not to wake it.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: I thought the old miners exaggerated. They did not have words large enough for what was sleeping here.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Before the first shaft was cut, this guardian carried the weight of the mountain across its back.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: Look at the marks around its feet. It has moved before, and every tunnel nearby learned to move with it.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: That is a new record. Do not break the rhythm now; the whole tunnel is opening in front of us.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: Did you feel that? Every strike landed clean, and the stone finally started keeping pace with us.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: New personal best. Hold the line, keep the timing, and make the next wall remember it too.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: I lost count somewhere behind us, but the echo did not. That was the cleanest run we have ever made.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: The pack is nearly sealed. Choose what matters now, or the next discovery stays buried where we found it.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: We have room for one careful choice, not another tunnel of maybes. Sort the bag before we dig deeper.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: Inventory is at the limit. Sell, store, or turn around; carrying greed is how good expeditions disappear.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: If I add one more crystal, this bag becomes architecture. We need a merchant before we need another vein.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: The Star is free. Listen to the silence around it; even the cave knows something impossible just happened.

clips.speaker: narrator
clips.text: Stone held its light for an age, but not forever. The buried sky has found its way back into the world.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: There you are. All that pressure, all that darkness, and you still remembered how to shine.

clips.speaker: player
clips.text: Easy, little Star. You have been waiting longer than we have been alive; take your time meeting the sky.
